links.outcome: Extent of clinician edits required to LLM-generated radiology report summaries before release
links.effect: Summaries required manual clinician edits: average 24.75 words removed, 0.13 words added per summary; lexical similarity 84.63%, semantic similarity 98.25%.
links.quote: However, LLM-summaries required manual clinician edits (average per summary: 24.75 words removed; 0.13 words added, lexical similarity = 84.63%; semantic similarity = 98.25%).

unlisted_practices: Interactive patient-facing AI radiology report summaries with clickable term definitions and AI-generated explanatory videos to improve comprehension

screen.reason: Prospective empirical study evaluating patient comprehension of clinician-edited LLM radiology summaries, directly quantifying the extent of clinician editing required and patient attitudes/comfort regarding the presence vs absence of clinician oversight.

primary.practice: clinician review and editing of LLM outputs
